requirements.title: Level-5 expressions are the logical-operator layers over level-4 expressions
requirements.definition: Level-5 expressions are level-4 expressions optionally involving .NOT., .AND., .OR., .EQV., and .NEQV. The grammar layers not before level-4, then and, then or, then equivalence.

pending.level-4-base: PENDING positive-control source shape using a relational level-4 expression as a level-5 expression with logical literal oracle.
pending.not-layer: PENDING positive-control source shape .NOT.(1==2) with logical oracle .true.; parentheses ensure the operand is a valid level-4 relation.
pending.and-layer: PENDING positive-control source shape .true. .AND. .false. with logical oracle .false. and a companion showing .NOT. binds inside the and-operand.
pending.or-layer: PENDING positive-control source shape .false. .OR. .true. .AND. .false. with literal oracle .false. to distinguish .AND. precedence over .OR.
pending.equivalence-layer: PENDING positive-control source shape .true. .EQV. .false. .OR. .false. with logical oracle .false., citing R1018 for lowest logical layer among intrinsic logical operators.

requirements.oracle: Future controls must use logical operands with literal truth tables and must not claim evaluation short-circuit behavior beyond later evaluation rules.

requirements.title: An and-operand is an optional .NOT. followed by a level-4 expression
requirements.definition: The and-operand syntax is an optional not-op followed by level-4-expr. A second unparenthesized not-op is not admitted by this rule because the operand after not-op is level-4, not another and-operand.

pending.level-4-only: PENDING positive-control source shape using 1==1 as an and-operand with logical oracle .true.
pending.not-level-4: PENDING positive-control source shape .NOT. (1==2) or .NOT. flag where the operand is a valid level-4 expression, with logical oracle .true.
pending.double-not-without-parentheses-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape .NOT. .NOT. flag without parentheses. Repair to .NOT.(.NOT.flag) or to a single .NOT. with a logical literal oracle, attributing the original violation to R1015 operand level rather than R1019 spelling.
pending.not-before-level-5-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape .NOT. (a .AND. b) only if parentheses are absent in the invalid form .NOT. a .AND. b is not claimed invalid; instead use a source where a level-5 expression appears where R1015 requires level-4. Repair with parentheses and literal truth oracle.

requirements.oracle: Negative plans must carefully avoid valid parses such as (.NOT. a) .AND. b; only forms where the token after .NOT. cannot be level-4 are attributable to R1015.

requirements.title: An or-operand is a left-recursive chain of and-operands joined by .AND.
requirements.definition: The or-operand syntax is either an and-operand or an or-operand followed by and-op and and-operand, giving .AND. left-recursive grouping above .OR. and equivalence.

pending.single-and-operand: PENDING positive-control source shape using .NOT. .false. only when parenthesized as needed to satisfy R1015, with oracle .true.
pending.and-chain: PENDING positive-control source shape .true. .AND. .false. with oracle .false.; R1020 owns the token.
pending.left-recursive-and: PENDING source-only grouping facet: R1016 is left-recursive for .AND. chains. For intrinsic LOGICAL operands, .AND. is associative in the two-valued logical table and 10.1.5.4.2 permits evaluation of any logically equivalent expression subject to parentheses, so a truth-value oracle cannot distinguish (a .AND. b) .AND. c from a .AND. (b .AND. c), and side-effect or operand-evaluation-path observations are nonportable. The concrete future route is a derived type with a non-associative defined extension of intrinsic operator .AND., distinct literal-bearing operands, and independently computed result-component values that differ for the left-recursive chain and a parenthesized right-grouping control; defined-operation applicability and interpretation are owned by 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2.
pending.missing-right-and-operand-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape '.true. .AND.' in an otherwise complete expression. Repair appends .false. and observes .false., isolating the missing R1016 right and-operand.

requirements.oracle: Intrinsic .AND. controls use LOGICAL operands and literal truth values for admission and truth-table checks only; they cannot observe grouping. The grouping facet can be addressed only by a value-based non-associative defined extension on a derived type with independently computed component oracles and valid defined-operation interfaces under 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2. Type errors remain 10.1.5.4 dependencies, not R1016 syntax evidence.

requirements.title: An equiv-operand is a left-recursive chain of or-operands joined by .OR.
requirements.definition: The equiv-operand syntax is either an or-operand or an equiv-operand followed by or-op and or-operand, placing .OR. below .AND. and above .EQV./.NEQV. in the grammar.

pending.single-or-operand: PENDING positive-control source shape using .true. .AND. .true. as an or-operand/equiv-operand with oracle .true.
pending.or-chain: PENDING positive-control source shape .false. .OR. .true. with oracle .true.; R1021 owns the token.
pending.and-before-or-precedence: PENDING positive-control source shape .true. .OR. .false. .AND. .false. with oracle .true., distinguishing R1016's tighter .AND. layer from .OR.
pending.missing-right-or-operand-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape '.false. .OR.' with valid left operand. Repair appends .true. and observes .true., isolating R1017 syntax.

requirements.oracle: Future controls must not rely on short-circuit behavior; only final logical values with literal operands are oracle material.

requirements.title: A level-5 expression is a left-recursive chain of equiv-operands joined by .EQV. or .NEQV.
requirements.definition: The level-5-expr syntax is either an equiv-operand or a level-5-expr followed by equiv-op and equiv-operand, making equivalence operators the lowest intrinsic logical layer and left-recursive.

pending.single-equiv-operand: PENDING positive-control source shape using an .OR. expression as a level-5 expression with logical literal oracle.
pending.eqv-chain: PENDING positive-control source shape .true. .EQV. .true. with oracle .true.; R1022 owns .EQV.
pending.neqv-chain: PENDING positive-control source shape .true. .NEQV. .false. with oracle .true.; R1022 owns .NEQV.
pending.left-recursive-equiv: PENDING source-only grouping facet: R1018 is left-recursive for .EQV./.NEQV. chains. For intrinsic LOGICAL operands, the two-valued truth tables make unparenthesized chains of .EQV. and .NEQV. value-associative, so left and right groupings have the same logical value for all primaries and side-effect/evaluation-order oracles are excluded by 10.1.5.4.2. The concrete future route is a derived type with non-associative defined extensions of .EQV. and/or .NEQV., distinct literal-bearing operands, and independently computed result-component values that differ for the R1018 left-recursive chain and a parenthesized right-grouping control; defined-operation applicability and interpretation are owned by 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2.
pending.missing-right-equiv-operand-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape '.true. .EQV.' with a valid left level-5 expression. Repair appends .false. and observes .false., isolating R1018 syntax.

requirements.oracle: Intrinsic LOGICAL controls can admit .EQV. and .NEQV. and check their truth tables, but they cannot close the left-recursive grouping facet because intrinsic .EQV./.NEQV. chains are value-associative in two-valued logic and 10.1.5.4.2 allows equivalent evaluation subject to parentheses. A future grouping oracle must use a non-associative defined extension on a derived type, independently computed component results for the two parenthesisations, and valid defined-operation interfaces under 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2; do not use side effects or operand evaluation paths.
